name: bro
description: Plain-language restatements, concise critical briefings, and request readbacks for alignment.

interface.shortDescription: Clear explanations, critical context, and alignment
interface.longDescription: Restate a previous response without jargon, give a capable engineer a concise briefing on an effort, or read back a request so the human can confirm alignment.
